brief.summary_1line: Rama and Ravana’s duel intensifies; Rama repeatedly severs Ravana’s regenerating heads while the cosmos trembles and gods watch anxiously.

image_candidates.scene_text: Rama’s arrow slices off Ravana’s jeweled head, which falls to the earth as another head instantly grows from the demon king’s body.
The two chariots halt face to face with shafts touching, horses pressing forward while Rama and Ravana fire torrents of arrows at point-blank range.
Gods and sages crowd the sky in alarm as the earth trembles, seas roar, and the darkened sun watches Rama battle Ravana below.

deep.rich_summary: As the climactic duel between Rama and Ravana continues, the two warriors charge across the battlefield in their chariots, circling and unleashing torrents of arrows like storm clouds. Their charioteers maneuver with dazzling skill while weapons—maces, clubs, axes, and shafts—fill the sky. The violence of the clash shakes the cosmos: seas churn, the earth trembles, the sun dims, and gods, sages, and celestial beings watch anxiously, praying for Rama’s victory. Rama cuts off one of Ravana’s heads, but another instantly grows in its place. Again and again he severs the demon king’s heads—dozens, even hundreds—yet Ravana does not fall. Confounded, Rama reflects that the same arrows that slew many terrible foes now seem powerless against Ravana, hinting that a deeper secret or divine strategy is required to end the battle.

highlight_spans.why: The opening frames the duel as a cosmic spectacle witnessed by all beings and sets the epic scale of the confrontation.
The description of the universe reacting—seas churning, earth shaking, sun dimming—elevates the duel to a mythic, world-shaking event.
Rama beheads Ravana for the first time and the head regrows, revealing the demon king’s terrifying resilience and shifting the stakes of the battle.
Rama’s internal reflection that his legendary arrows now fail against Ravana captures a rare moment of doubt in the hero amid the titanic struggle.
